text.title: User Story Mapping Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply User Story Mapping end-to-end. Each step names its input, action, and output.

step.name: frame-journey
step.action: Define the user, the big goal, and where the journey starts and ends. One persona only (r5).
step.decision-gate: If more than one persona is in scope, stop and split into one map per persona.

step.name: backbone
step.action: Lay out 5-10 verb-phrase activities left-to-right, then read the row aloud as a narrative (r1).
step.decision-gate: If the row reads as nouns or does not form a coherent story, re-cut before continuing.

step.name: tasks
step.action: Under each activity list 2-5 user tasks ordered by priority, including ≥1 error path or empty state per activity (r6).

step.name: stories
step.action: Per task, build a vertical column of alternative stories, MVP at top, capped at 6 (r3).

step.name: draw-skeleton
step.action: Draw the line separating the walking skeleton — exactly one task per activity — from the rest (r2).

step.name: slice-releases
step.action: Partition the remaining tasks into release rows, each spanning the full backbone (r7). Cut by moving stories below the line, never by deleting them (r4).
step.decision-gate: If a proposed release does not touch every activity, rebalance before publishing.
